_comment: Copy to config.json (or set another path via the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file contains only database and skill_dir; other settings such as LLM go through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Choose one of two styles: (A) fill in the separate fields below; (B) fill in only database.dsn as a single full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): remove the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the separate fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
